description: This file contains the implementation of the jScrollPane plugin, a JavaScript library for customizable scrollbars in web pages. It includes license information, plugin version history, and the core code defining the jScrollPane class, initialization routines, scrollbar sizing, and event handling.

classes.name: JScrollPane
classes.description: Main class implementing the custom scrollbar functionality, including initialization, event handling, and scrollbar sizing.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes the scrollbar, sets up DOM elements, and determines if scrollbars are needed.

methods.name: initialiseVerticalScroll
methods.description: Sets up the vertical scrollbar if content overflows vertically.

methods.name: sizeVerticalScrollbar
methods.description: Calculates and sets the size of the vertical scrollbar.

methods.name: initialiseHorizontalScroll
methods.description: Sets up the horizontal scrollbar if content overflows horizontally.

methods.name: sizeHorizontalScrollbar
methods.description: Calculates and sets the size of the horizontal scrollbar.

methods.name: resizeScrollbars
methods.description: Adjusts scrollbar sizes and positions when container size changes.

methods.name: appendArrows
methods.description: Adds arrow buttons to scrollbars based on position preferences.

methods.name: getArrowScroll
methods.description: Returns a function to handle arrow button scrolling.

methods.name: arrowScroll
methods.description: Performs scrolling when arrow buttons are pressed.

methods.name: initClickOnTrack
methods.description: Enables clicking on scrollbar tracks to scroll content.
